items.rationale: The original DEX/MDA dictionary senses locate a storm in atmospheric disturbance; NWS describes lightning as an electrical discharge through air and thunder as the resulting sound. NASA identifies the Moon as Earth’s natural satellite. The shared predicate therefore applies to all three phenomena and excludes the celestial body. It does not imply every storm has thunder or that the Moon is part of Earth’s atmosphere. Ordinary unqualified weather senses match the stored descriptions.

Named dictionary definitions support a leaf as a plant organ, a branch as a stem ramification, banana as a fruit, and flour as milled cereal grain. The qualified leaf/branch label states a possible growing position, not a universal attachment rule. Cat and dog have familiar domestic senses and the European Commission explicitly treats both as companion animals. Wheat/flour states one ordinary production relation, without asserting all flour is wheat or classifying a banana plant as a tree. The native descriptions retain these ordinary senses.
